source_title: Bank of Baroda Personal Loan Overview
raw_quote: Bank of Baroda Personal Loan for personal, medical, wedding, and emergency needs.
Unsecured retail personal loan.
No collateral, guarantor or mortgage required for eligible personal loans.
Personal loan eligibility depends upon an individual's occupation, account relationship with our bank or the other bank, income, and CIBIL score.
Must be an Indian resident citizen.
Individuals with a minimum age of 21 years.
Maximum age at conclusion of loan: 58-60 years for salaried individuals (up to 65 for self-employed/pensioners).
They should be gainfully employed or self-employed.
Minimum continuous service of 1 year in present organization.

source_title: Bank of Baroda Minimum Salary Policy
raw_quote: What is the minimum salary to get a personal loan? There is no such stipulation if one has a minimum salary to get a personal loan.

source_title: Bank of Baroda Entry Floor Policy
raw_quote: Can I get a personal loan if my salary is Rs. 10,000? Yes, you can get a personal loan subject to the fulfilment of other terms and conditions.
Their income should be sufficient to repay the EMI of the loan, etc. and the CIBIL score must be above 701 and above.

raw_quote: Prime bureau score benchmark of 750+ qualifies for lowest BRLLR spread.

In semi-urban and rural areas, the loan amount varies from Rs. 50,000 up to Rs. 15 lakhs.
Maximum loan amount in semi-urban and rural areas: Rs. 15 Lakhs.
